hooks.command: filepath=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path') && echo "$filepath" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' && npx eslint --fix "$filepath" 2>/dev/null || true

filepath=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path') && case "$filepath" in */apps/api/*) pnpm --filter @myapp/api typecheck 2>&1 | tail -20;; */apps/web/*) pnpm --filter @myapp/web typecheck 2>&1 | tail -20;; */packages/types/*) pnpm --filter @myapp/types typecheck 2>&1 | tail -20;; esac || true
filepath=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path') && echo "$filepath" | grep -qE '\.test\.' && npx vitest --run "$filepath" 2>&1 | tail -20 || true
